    Studio

    O nosso habitat criativo no Chiado

    byGrain© is a house of ideas that works with artists. We direct and produce films, lead creative direction, and build aesthetic universes with their own cultural identity.

    Films & music videos

    Direction, cinematography, editing and colour, from treatment to final grade.

    Creative direction

    The visual world around a release or an artist, across every format.

    Production

    Crew, casting, locations and logistics for shoots of every size.

    3D, VFX & merch

    3D and effects work in-house, plus merchandise through the byGrain© Store.
